script:
We've been exploring the cosmos for decades, and what have we found? A galaxy made of dark matter, invisible to our telescopes. It's like something out of a horror movie.

The Oumuamua object that passed through our solar system was like nothing scientists had ever seen before. A rogue asteroid or comet? No one knows.

But the most disturbing discovery has to be the "Wow! Signal". In 1977, a strong, narrowband radio signal was picked up by a telescope in Ohio. It lasted for 72 seconds and was so strong it's been dubbed the "most promising candidate" for extraterrestrial life ever detected.

What is that? We may never know. All we can do is wonder...
